نتناعس (form VI)
# نَتَنَاعَسُ (natanāʕasu) /na.ta.naː.ʕa.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاعَسَ (tanāʕasa)
# نَتَنَاعَسَ (natanāʕasa) /na.ta.naː.ʕa.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاعَسَ (tanāʕasa)
# نَتَنَاعَسْ (natanāʕas) /na.ta.naː.ʕas/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاعَسَ (tanāʕasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
